args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary (Brightline blog + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of the Brightline cold-chain piece and its companion:

- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.

Sources:
- https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain
- https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion
